import math

INF = 1e9

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
    
    minDiff = INF
    bestNum = 0
    bestDen = 0
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        tx = round(x * i / y - 1e-7)
        diff = abs(x / y - tx / i)
        
        if diff < minDiff:
            minDiff = diff
            bestNum = tx
            bestDen = i
    
    print(f"{bestNum}/{bestDen}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
